headline: A decade of elite men's soccer as seen through the FC 100
description: We've been tracking the FC 100 since 2016 and a lot has changed in the game -- though Lionel Messi has been ever-present. Gab Marcotti reflects on the list, its growth and what it shows you about men's soccer.

headline: Liverpool's Curtis Jones close to deal to join Inter Milan - sources
description: Inter Milan are closing in on a deal to sign Liverpool midfielder Curtis Jones, sources told ESPN.

headline: Arsenal agree deal for Aston Villa's Ezri Konsa - sources
description: Arsenal have agreed a deal worth in the region of £51million for Aston Villa defender Ezri Konsa, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Is Baleba the best replacement for Casemiro at Man United?
description: Brighton midfielder Carlos Baleba looks set to join Manchester United, but is he the right choice?

headline: Arsenal 'not actively seeking' Myles Lewis-Skelly, Ethan Nwaneri exits but will consider 'right opportunity'
description: Arsenal would consider exits for Myles Lewis-Skelly and Ethan Nwaneri if "the right opportunity" came up but are not actively seeking their departure, CEO Richard Garlick told BBC Sport.

headline: Man United in talks with Brighton for Carlos Baleba - sources
description: Manchester United are in talks with Brighton over a deal for Carlos Baleba, sources have told ESPN.
